articles.summary: Anavex Life Sciences Corp. (“Anavex” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: AVXL), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative treatments for Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, schizophrenia, neurodevelopmental, neurodegenerative, and rare diseases, including Rett syndrome, and other central nervous system (CNS) disorders, today announced that Christopher U Missling, PhD, President & Chief Executive Officer, will present at the Citizens Life Sciences Conference on Tuesday, March 10th, 2026 at 11:55 AM (ET).
articles.title: Anavex Life Sciences to Present at the Citizens Life Sciences Conference

articles.summary: Anavex (AVXL) provides a regulatory update on blarcamesine, including ongoing EMA dialogue and FDA discussions toward potential Alzheimer’s NDA pathways.
articles.title: Anavex Life Sciences Provides Comprehensive Regulatory Update

articles.summary: Anavex (AVXL) reports blarcamesine restored motor function and dopaminergic nerve fibers in a Parkinson’s disease model presented at AD/PD 2026.
articles.title: Anavex Life Sciences Presents Significant Treatment Effects of Blarcamesine in New Advanced Alpha-Synuclein Model of Parkinson’s Disease at AD/PD 2026 Conference

articles.summary: Anavex (AVXL) highlights new research showing autophagy failure as an early driver of Alzheimer’s disease, supporting blarcamesine’s SIGMAR1 mechanism.
articles.title: New Scientific Findings Highlight Hypothesis of Autophagy Failure as a Precursor of Amyloid Beta and Tau Pathology in Alzheimer’s Disease

articles.summary: Anavex (AVXL) reports AD-004 data showing oral blarcamesine preserves brain volume and correlates with clinical outcomes in early Alzheimer’s disease.
articles.title: Anavex Life Sciences Presents New Data from its AD-004 Phase IIb/III Trial at AD/PD 2026 Conference Demonstrating Consistent Correlation Between the Treatment Effect of Oral Blarcamesine and Preservation of Brain Volume in Early Alzheimer’s Disease

articles.summary: Anavex (AVXL) provides an update on EU regulatory review of blarcamesine for early Alzheimer’s disease following EMA feedback.
articles.title: Anavex Life Sciences Provides Update on Regulatory Review in the EU for Blarcamesine to Treat Early Alzheimer’s Disease
